title: LightCarbon LCR018-D owner build review
notes: Exact size-58 owner build measured 8.6 kg with pedals, storage and bottle cages, 8.35 kg without pedals, 1,196 g painted frame and 463 g fork. The owner reports a USD 950 custom-painted frameset and USD 1,790 discounted complete build. A 40 mm rear/45 mm front fit is an owner observation, not the manufacturer's universal maximum.
